title: Arizona Desert Guided E-Bike Adventure
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
All rides subject to weather and trail conditions. This includes temperature.
Basic bike skills required!! (balancing, braking, pedaling and shifting gears).
Not recommended for guests with balance issues
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embark on a thrilling electric bike adventure in the breathtaking Sonoran Desert! Since our inception in 2012, we have proudly been Arizona's first e-bike adventure outfitter, specializing in exciting on-road and off-road experiences that elevate your exploration of the desert landscape. Our high-quality Class 1 e-bikes, featuring advanced Bosch and Yamaha motors, provide an unmatched riding experience, effortlessly tackling the varied terrain of the desert. Unlike traditional mountain biking or hiking, our e-bikes allow you to cover more ground and access hidden gems that are often missed on foot or standard bikes. With our knowledgeable guides leading the way, you’ll have the chance to engage deeply with the beauty of the Sonoran Desert. Enjoy stunning vistas, learn about the local flora and fauna, and soak in the unique ambiance of this remarkable environment.
